sentence_stem: If I had studied harder at school,
correct_completion: I would have a better job now.
full_sentence: If I had studied harder at school, I would have a better job now.
acceptable_variants: I would be earning much more money now.
I would be in a far better position today.

options.text: I will have a better job next year.
options.why_wrong: The stem is an unreal past condition, so the result needs the hypothetical 'would', not a real future 'will'.

options.text: I have a better job now.
options.why_wrong: This states a real present fact and leaves out the conditional result, so it does not complete the hypothetical sentence.

options.text: I would have a better job now.
I would have had a better job last year.
options.why_wrong: This refers to the past, but a mixed conditional with a past condition and a present result needs a result about now.

grammar_focus: Mixed conditionals: past unreal condition with present result
explanation: The stem uses the past perfect in an unreal condition about the past, while the result refers to the present. This is the mixed conditional pattern. Turkish speakers often choose a simple past or a plain present result here, because Turkish conditional suffixes do not separate past condition from present result in the same way.
translation: Okulda daha çok çalışsaydım, şimdi daha iyi bir işim olurdu.
